method.title: From chaos to likeness
method.lead: Every image starts from elements scattered at random. For thousands of generations the best ones are picked, tweaked and crossed, until the photograph resurfaces.
step.select.title: Selection
step.select.text: Among the candidate images, those closest to the photograph win in small tournaments.
step.cross.title: Crossover
step.cross.text: Sometimes two parents swap part of their elements; other times the child is a copy.
step.mutate.title: Mutation
step.mutate.text: Every child changes a little: an element moves, changes colour, a new one arrives or one disappears.
step.repeat.title: Repeat
step.repeat.text: The best ones move on to the next generation. The error drops, the photo emerges.
curve.title: The error, generation after generation
curve.text: How far the image is from the photo, pixel by pixel. It drops sharply in the first generations, then every improvement costs more and more: that is where the details emerge.
shapes.title: Drawing techniques
shapes.lead: The same algorithm, different elements. Each leaves a recognisable mark on the photo.
